name: Spell Threat
description: Custom threat values for spells: flat threat added, a threat multiplier and an attack power based bonus. Define only the first rank of a spell, data is propagated to higher ranks unless a rank is listed explicitly.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Should be the first rank of the spell chain, higher ranks inherit the data

fields.name: Threat
fields.help: Flat threat added by the spell

fields.name: Multiplier
fields.help: Multiplier applied to the threat generated by the spell's damage/heal

fields.name: Ap Bonus
fields.help: Additional flat threat equal to this coefficient times the caster's attack power

fields.name: Inverse Effect Mask
fields.help: Bitmask of spell effect indexes (1 = effect 0, 2 = effect 1, 4 = effect 2) whose threat is applied inversely (negative)
